newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl optimistic Germany to meet EMU criteria.
newsitem.headline: Kohl optimistic Germany to meet EMU criteria.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said he is sure Germany will meet the criteria to participate in European monetary union (EMU) at the scheduled January 1999 start.
"Without question, we will keep to the timetable and the criteria," Kohl said at the 25th anniversary of software group SAP AG.

In this connection, however, Germany has not yet completed all its tasks. "There is still a lot to do, even without EMU," he said, adding that Germany still had good chances despite its current difficulties.

The government officially projects that the budget deficit will be reduced to below the three percent threshold required for participation in EMU, but many observers, including the European Union, predict the deficit will be higher.
